opening.argument: The presentation walks viewers through Facebook support resources for account and advertising issues. The speaker explains that the support center has forms for many problems and points viewers toward contact forms and chat support when it is available. The screen-recorded pages reinforce that purpose: they show a Facebook Business Ads Help Center with categories for ads, pages, and billing, and a form for reporting a Home Page or News Feed issue. These are operational instructions for finding support, not requests for payment, credentials, investment participation, or other financial action. The unrelated course, book, subscription, and social-media links are not shown to be connected to the support-form instructions or to deceptive conduct.
